children: American Water filed a joint petition for a non-unanimous settlement in the Pennsylvania PUC proceeding related to its proposed merger with Essential Utilities.
Filed joint petition on Sept. 15, 2026 for a non-unanimous settlement in the PaPUC review of the proposed merger.
Settlement reached with PaPUC enforcement bureau, consumer advocate, small business advocate and certain parties; some parties did not join.
Administrative Law Judges will review and issue a Recommended Decision before PaPUC consideration and potential approval.
Filing underscores regulatory steps remaining and potential timing/conditions that could affect closing of the merger.
